item.title: ‘Refusal must be reasoned/justified’; Bombay HC sets aside Labour Court’s order refusing advocate representation to a legally untrained person
item.description: “When a party demonstrates genuine inability to represent itself and seeks professional assistance without mala fides, the Labour Court ought to grant such leave unless strong reasons exist to the contrary.” The post ‘Refusal must be reasoned/justified’; Bombay HC sets aside Labour Court’s order refusing advocate representation to a legally untrained person appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Madras HC permits the devotees to Light Karthigai Deepam at Deepathoon; holds officials in contempt
item.description: “Confirming the conviction under the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 only to send across the right message… a clear message should be sent so that no one, howsoever high they may be, may think that they are above the law.” The post Madras HC permits the devotees to Light Karthigai Deepam at Deepathoon; holds officials in contempt appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: ‘Merit alone counts at Super Speciality level’: Orissa High Court dismisses plea for reservation in Assistant Professor posts
item.description: “The post in other disciplines have already been filled up and none of the appointees are party to the writ petition and in absence of them, their selection and appointment cannot be interfered with.” The post ‘Merit alone counts at Super Speciality level’: Orissa High Court dismisses plea for reservation in Assistant Professor posts appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Work from Home cannot give parent an upper hand regarding child custody matters: Supreme Court
item.description: The Court stated that with working parents, it is expected that they cannot always be physically with their children, however, this cannot be a ground to place the child’s custody with the parent who may be temporarily working from home. The post Work from Home cannot give parent an upper hand regarding child custody matters: Supreme Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Punjab and Haryana High Court quashes FIR against AAP leaders in protest over Lakhimpur Kheri incident
item.description: “In the absence of any allegation of commission of the offences by an unlawful assembly, as chargesheet has not been filed under Sections 147 as 147 and 149 of the IPC, the petitioners cannot be held liable for the alleged acts of causing hurt or assault by any of the protestors, even if the allegations are accepted of accepted as true.” The post Punjab and Haryana High Court quashes FIR against AAP leaders in protest over Lakhimpur Kheri incident appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Justice J.S. Verma Fellowship Scheme: Opportunities for Young Advocates
item.description: To identify and support promising young advocates in Supreme Court litigation, the Supreme Court Lawyers Welfare Trust has instituted the Justice J.S. Verma Fellowships. The post Justice J.S. Verma Fellowship Scheme: Opportunities for Young Advocates appeared first on SCC Times.
